title: agrostis truncatula subsp. durieui
intro: Agrostis truncatula subsp. durieui, commonly known as the Durie's bentgrass, is a subspecies of the Agrostis truncatula plant. It is a type of flowering plant in the grass family, Poaceae. Durie's bentgrass has been studied for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and other secondary metabolites that are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing and calming effects.
